name: AI Outbound Sales Caller – Call Dispatcher

nodes.name: Claim Row (Dispatching)
nodes.notes: Claims the row BEFORE calling the API, so an overlapping run or a crash can never dial it twice.

nodes.name: Dispatch Call - OmniDimension
nodes.notes: NO automatic retry: a retried POST can place a second real phone call. All outcomes are classified in the next node.

nodes.name: Raise Dispatch Alert
nodes.notes: Fails the execution on purpose so the Error Alerts workflow emails the team.
